nb-api-specs.description: Released NASEBANAL API contracts. This repo is public and cannot read the private @nasebanal/api-specs-* packages, so the released version is served over plain HTTP instead. The feed is generated by nb-api-specs' copy-specs.mjs from released.json, which only advances once the provider has deployed the contract — the same gate the private consumers get from the @latest dist-tag.

customManagers.description: spec-versions.json pins which contract this repo generates its command tree from. A bump here is a real behaviour change, so it goes through a PR like any dependency.
